verdict.rationale: Direct probes show Aider publishes no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown/agent-oriented docs variant (HTTP 404 for .html.md). Nothing else in the pack documents agent-oriented documentation. The /web command, which scrapes a page into chat, is a different capability (ingesting arbitrary pages) and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
